about_the_game:
Set sail and live the pirate’s life. The multiplayer pirate survival game where you mine, craft and plunder to survive. Form alliances to strengthen your crew and wage war on your enemies. Fight to keep what’s yours before others take it.

In Sails, you step into a multiplayer world where piracy rules the seas and every decision can mean life or death. Navigate a vast world alongside friends and build your stronghold to secure your place in this world. Explore islands, raid large forts, and form powerful alliances to survive the constant threats from other crews. Command your ship through intense naval battles where strategy and teamwork decides the victor. In Sails the open ocean is yours to conquer, only if you’re ready to face the dangers lurking beyond the horizon.

                                                               SAIL THE SEAS

Explore a dynamic world ruled by rival factions with each controlling specific regions. Command a variety of ships, from small sloops to powerful galleons. Customize the interior of your ship to suit your playstyle. Navigate treacherous waters and chart your course through danger and opportunity.

  • Large Open world

  • Territories ruled by factions

  • Multiple Ships

  • Buildable Ship interior

                                                      RAID AND PLUNDER

Battle rival crews across land and sea in exciting raids. Lay siege to enemy bases, steal their loot, and defend your own from other pirates. Attack on land or use naval bombardment to soften targets. When you're not fighting players, raid NPC towns, tribal villages, and strongholds for extra rewards.

  • Raid rival crews for their loot

  • Explore abandoned ships and shipwrecks

  • Plunder towns, villages, and forts

  • Find hidden dungeons

                                                         BUILD AND CRAFT

Shape your world from the ground up. Build coastal bases, island forts, or hidden hideouts with your crew. Craft anything from weapons and armor to tools and ship upgrades. Fortify your base, set traps, and prepare for enemy raids. Whether you're the builder or a fighter, survival starts with what you create.

  • Craft weapons, tools, armor and ships

  • Construct your fortress

  • Form a crew with friends

  • Build traps and fortifications

content_descriptors.notes:
Pirates can be found hanging by noose in certain parts of the world and dead in cages. Violence includes animals/humans being shot, stabbed and blown up by explosions. This includes voxel depictions of limbs and blood.
Players may be nude but there is no character genitalia and no sexual acts.
